x-k-k5-06.title: Kukanzura nguva yekusangana naprofesa
x-k-k5-06.goal: Sarudza zvisipo mumeseji yekukanzura yakanyorerwa shamwari, wobva wainyorera profesa.
x-k-k5-06.material:
Wakanga une nguva yekusangana neprofesa wako mangwana pa 3:00. Tafura yekirasi yako yachinja zvino zvino uye haugone kuenda. Mbishi yako yekutanga:
"교수님, 내일 3시에 못 가요. 다른 일이 있어요. 다음에 갈게요."
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.prompt: Matambudziko api anoitwa nembishi iyi kuPROFESA anoiverenga?
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira uri profesa: waizoda kuziva chii mushure mekuiverenga?
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa sarudzo imwe neimwe nemazwi chaiwo embishi.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.o.a: Haitaure kuti ndiani ari kunyora kana kirasi ipi
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.a: Profesa anogamuchira mameseji mazhinji uye anoda kuziva anotumira nekosi.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.b: Nguva neizwi 내일 zvinoratidza kuti nguva yekusangana ipi inoreva; chikamu ichocho chembishi chinoshanda.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.c: '다음에' i yakawandisa kusajeka kuti profesa aronge nayo.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.d: Mbishi inoshandisa zvimiro zve present/future (못 가요, 갈게요), kwete past.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.r.e: Kukanzura nguva pfupi kunodawo kukumbira ruregerero.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.explain: Mbishi inotaura nguva yekusangana asi isingatauri munyori, hairevi ruregerero chero kupi, uye inosiya nhanho inotevera yakavhurika. Tense yakanaka uye nguva yakajeka.
x-k-k5-06.s.s1.acc.0: Muverengi anogona kunzwa kuti kukumbira ruregerero i nyaya yeinzwi kwete zvirimo; munyori nenguva itsva zvichiri zvisipo zvakakosha.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.prompt: Nyora patsva meseji yeprofesa muKorea: zvizivise nekirasi yako, kumbira ruregerero, ipa chikonzero chipfupi, uye ukurudzire nguva itsva. Shandisa kupera kwepamutemo nekuremekedza.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rongera zvikamu zvina: ndiani, ruregerero, chikonzero, nguva itsva.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza kupera kwe -ㅂ니다 kana -세요 nguva dzose.
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Profesa angapindura 'hongu' asina mimwe mibvunzo here?
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Nguva itsva yakajeka here (zuva nenguva yezuva)?
x-k-k5-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Kupera kwangu kwese kunoramba kuri kwepamutemo here?

x-k-k5-08.title: Ndiani aiva kuraibhurari?
x-k-k5-08.goal: Enzanisa nhoroondo nhatu dzemasikati akafanana uye utaure zvinogona uye zvisingagone kusvikwa, wobva wataura nzira yekuwana zvakawanda.
x-k-k5-08.material:
Kirasi inopera pa 3:30. Imba yaMinsu iri 30 maminitsi ekufamba kubva kuchikoro, uye anogara achifamba (hapana bhazi). Vadzidzi vatatu vanotaura mangwana acho.
민수: 어제 수업이 끝나고 바로 집에 갔어요.
하나: 어제 4시쯤 도서관에서 민수 씨를 봤어요. 책을 빌리고 있었어요.
준호: 저는 4시 30분쯤 도서관에 있었는데 민수 씨는 못 봤어요.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.prompt: Chii chaunogona kusvika mushure menhoroondo tatu?
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti Minsu aizova kumba rini kana akabva pakarepo.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nguva yenhoroondo imwe neimwe neimwe: ipi mapoka akafukidza nguva imwechete?
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.a: Nhoroondo dzaHana naMinsu dzinopokana, uye yaJunho haisarudzi pakati padzo
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.a: Minsu aisazova kumba pamberi pe 4:00 kana akafamba achienda kumba, saka haagone kuva kuraibhurari pa 4:00; nguva yaJunho yakasiyana.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.b: Minsu ari kunyepa nezvekuenda kumba pakarepo, nekuti Hana akamuona kuraibhurari
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.b: Nhoroondo imwe inopokana neimwe, asi kupokana hakuratidzi kuti ndiani akakanganisa kana kuti pane akanyepa.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.c: Hana anofanira kunge akakanganisa, nekuti Junho akanga ari kuraibhurari gare gare uye haana kuona Minsu
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.c: Junho akasvika hafu yeawa gare gare kupfuura nguva yaunopa Hana, saka nhoroondo yake haitaure chinhu nezve 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.o.d: Nhoroondo dzose tatu dzinogona kuva dzechokwadi panguva imwe chete, sezvo pasina anopa nguva yeawachi
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.r.d: Kuva kumba pa 4:00 nekukweretesa bhuku kuraibhurari pa 4:00 hazvigoni kuva zvechokwadi zvose kumunhu mumwe.
x-k-k5-08.s.s1.explain: Kufamba kuenda kumba pakarepo kunotora kusvika anenge 4:00, saka Minsu haagone kuva kuraibhurari pa 4:00. Kana Minsu kana Hana akakanganisa (kana 'shure kwa 4' zvichireva zvisiri zvakananga). Junho akasvika pa 4:30, saka haaratidzi chinhu nezve 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.prompt: MuChirungu, taura chinhu chimwe chaungabvunza kana kutarisa kuti uwane kuti ndiani akarurama, uchireketa mazwi eKorea anokuita kuti usahadzike.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nguva mbiri dzinopokana uye ubvunze kuti chii chingazvisiyanisa.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.hint.1: Kutarisa kwakanaka i chinhu chinogona kuitwa nemunhu chaizvo.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kutarisa kwandakakurudzira kunosiyanisa zvingaitika chaizvo here?
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.0: Bvunza Hana kuti ane chokwadi sei ne '4시쯤' uye kana akataura naye, uye ubvunze Minsu kuti akasvika kumba nguva ipi, nekuti '바로 집에 갔어요' inofanira kureva kuti aiva kumba anenge 4:00.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.1: Tarisa rekodhi yekukweretesa yeraibhurari: kana Minsu akakweretesa bhuku anenge '4시쯤' saka Hana akarurama; '4시 30분쯤' yaJunho i hafu yeawa gare gare, saka haisarudzi chinhu.
x-k-k5-08.s.s2.model.2: Ndaizoshanyira raibhurari uye ndotarisa marekodhi ekukweretesa kuti ndione kuti Minsu akakweretesa bhuku rini, nekuti Hana anoti '4시쯤' asi Minsu anoti '바로 집에 갔어요'.

x-k-k5-09.title: Rega muverengi afungidzire chikonzero
x-k-k5-09.topic: kunyora nezvakapfuura kuti chikonzero chigone kufungidzirwa
x-k-k5-09.goal: Taura kuti matsamba mapfupi api asingataure chikonzero, wobva wanyora yako kuti muverengi afungidzire chikonzero asingaudzwi.
x-k-k5-09.material: Matsamba mana mapfupi, imwe neimwe ichitsanangura chimwe chinhu chakaitika. Mune mamwe, chikonzero chinotaurwa nemazwi; mune mamwe, muverengi anofanira kuchifungidzira.
x-k-k5-09.prereq.0: Unoziva past tense ne -아서/어서/그래서 semazwi echikonzero
x-k-k5-09.prereq.1: Unonyora mitsara yakati wandei yakareruka muKorea
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.prompt: Matsamba MAVIRI api chikonzero CHISINGATAURWE nemazwi, asi muverengi achigona kuchifungidzira?
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga tsamba imwe neimwe uye ubvunze 'sei izvi zvakaitika?'. Wobva watarisa kana tsamba ichipindura mubvunzo uyu nemazwi.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kana, uchibvisa mazwi echikonzero, ungagona kufungidzira zvakaitika.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.a: '몸이 아파서' inotaura chikonzero ne -아서, saka hapana kufungidzira kunodiwa.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.b: Hapana izwi rechikonzero rinoonekwa, asi 병원, 약 ne 누웠어요 pamwe chete zvinoita kuti muverengi afungidzire kurwara.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.r.c: Hapana izwi rechikonzero rinoonekwa, asi kusava nemvumbi pamwe nezvipfeko zvakanyorova zvinoita kuti muverengi afungidzire mvura.
x-k-k5-09.s.s1.explain: Mu b ne c muverengi anofanira kubatanidza ruzivo (chipatara + mushonga, kana kusava nemvumbi + zvipfeko zvakanyorova). Mu a ne d izwi rechikonzero (-아서, 그래서) rinoratidza pachena.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mitsara 2-3 yeKorea nezvechimwe chakaitika svondo rapera (rako kana rakagadzirwa) kuti chikonzero chechimwe chinhu chisingataurwe asi chigone kufungidzirwa. Usashandise kupera kwechikonzero (-아서/어서/해서, -니까), 그래서, 때문에 kana 이유. (가서/와서 se 'enda wobva waita' zvakanaka.)
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza chikonzero kutanga, wobva wasarudza zvidimbu zviviri zvinoratidza zvakananga pachiri usingachitaure.
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Shamwari yepaklasi ingafungidzira chikonzero kubva pazvidimbu zvangu here?
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakadzivirira mazwi ese echikonzero akananga here?
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Mutsara mumwe nemumwe uri mu past tense yakajairika here?
x-k-k5-09.s.s2.modelNote.2: Kurwara kunosiiwa kumuverengi; 가서 i nhevedzano, kwete chikonzero.
